searches.answer: Kubernetes 1.20 will begin deprecating Docker runtime support, with plans to remove it entirely in version 1.22. This change is due to Docker runtime's non-compliance with the Kubernetes Container Runtime Interface (CRI). Users running open-source Kubernetes clusters will need to transition to compliant runtimes like containerd or CRI-O. Docker Desktop has released updates including Kubernetes v1.34.3 and cri-dockerd v0.4.4. The Kubernetes project maintains release branches for the most recent three minor releases, with versions 1.37, 1.36, and 1.35 currently supported.
